rationale: Pre-model-fit code review identified a model-capacity asymmetry: the process-first route can retain more than eight predictors while the predeclared primary flat selector is capped at eight. Add an all-46 same-learner report-only control so any predictive advantage can be separated from simple predictor-count capacity. This amendment was frozen after some preeligibility support shards had materialized but before candidate-level all46 eligibility was aggregated, before final50 was known, before numeric final50 features or any model fit, and before answer-check opening.

added_report_only_route.name: full_46_flat_hgb
added_report_only_route.training_rows: same model-pool occurrences and background_rank mod 5 != 0 rows as every other route
added_report_only_route.sealed_rows: same answer-check occurrences and background_rank mod 5 == 0 rows as every other route

interpretation_boundary.process_first_filtering_predictive_advan: all 50 capacity comparisons are evaluable AND paired bootstrap 95% lower bound for SDMR minus full46 balanced-log-score gain > 0
interpretation_boundary.otherwise: Do not attribute the original EMP-A/B gain specifically to process-aware filtering; report that comparison as advantage over the frozen <=8-predictor flat selector only.

prohibited: use the capacity control to retune SDMR or the primary flat selector
drop taxa based on the capacity-control result
open answer-check before all model-pool routes including full46 are frozen
